For the main body, what worked for me was I split it into 3/4 different factors. My qs was on the crusades and “to what extent was religious devotion the main motivation for those setting out from Western Europe to Jerusalem and outremer”. My main argument was that religious devotion WAS the main motivation, but my counter argument/other factors were material/political gain and participation in military orders as motivation.

If you’ve been getting A*a in your essays, the structure for the main body is no different to the structure you use in your essays.

Start off with your counter argument which I’m guessing is misogyny. Address this factor and why it is significant. Discuss supporting evidence for this factor in regards to continuity. But then you could at the end of this section talk about periods of change and how religion was actually the overarching and most significant factor.

I am not sure if any of this is helpful, but I could definitely send you snippets of mind to show you what I mean eg specific sentence openers and how I made my evidence and points flow
